extensionDescription.message: Local-first screenshot capture for visible areas, full pages and selected regions.

captureVisibleHint.message: Save the current viewport as PNG

captureFullHint.message: Scroll, stitch and save the page locally

captureRegionHint.message: Drag over the exact area you need

selectRegion.message: Drag to select a region on the page.

captureBusy.message: Another SNAPVERE capture is already active.

captureTabChanged.message: The active tab changed during capture. Start the capture again on the tab you want.

unsupportedPage.message: This browser page does not allow screenshot injection or capture.

fullPageTooLarge.message: This page is too large for safe full-page capture.

regionInstruction.message: Drag to select an area. Press Esc to cancel.

fullPageLimitNote.message: Full-page results can vary on video, canvas, cross-origin frames and highly dynamic pages.

fileNamingNote.message: Saved captures always use the SNAPVERE filename prefix.

askWhereToSave.message: Ask where to save visible and region captures

settingsLoadFailed.message: Settings could not be loaded. Safe defaults remain active.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Settings could not be saved. Try again.

privacyNote.message: Screenshots are processed locally. SNAPVERE does not upload captures, run analytics or use telemetry.

recentDescription.message: The latest completed SNAPVERE PNG downloads from this browser profile.

openDownloadsFolderFailed.message: The browser could not open the default downloads folder.

recentReady.message: Recent captures are up to date.

noRecentCaptures.message: No completed SNAPVERE captures were found in browser downloads.

recentLoadFailed.message: Recent captures could not be read from browser downloads.

openCaptureFailed.message: This capture could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted.

openSettingsFailed.message: Settings could not be opened. Try again from the browser extension menu.
